situations.headline: Austal confirms preliminary, unsolicited talks with Wildcat Infrastructure — no proposal received

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Austal confirms preliminary, unsolicited talks with Wildcat Infrastructure — no proposal received (interest 5, risk 3)

thesis.text: Austal is a strategically significant defence shipbuilder (Australia's Strategic Shipbuilder, largest defence exporter) that has become subject to preliminary, unsolicited takeover interest from Wildcat Infrastructure; no formal proposal exists yet, so the situation is purely speculative pending further disclosure, but the strategic asset base and government relationships warrant close monitoring of any follow-up announcements.
